Game Overview

Obby - World Champions puts players into a boxing experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Obby - World Champions is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Obby - World Champions?

Obby - World Champions is a free boxing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Obby - World Champions free to play?

Yes, Obby - World Champions is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
